schema.description:
ResolveSessionViewerRequest opens the device view of an existing session
for an authenticated caller who may already see that session (its owner
for a user-owned session, any workspace member for a workspace-owned one).
The response is the preview viewer's bootstrap (ResolvePreviewLinkResponse
with attach_only = true): the same stream grant, gateway routing and device
state a preview link's resolve returns, for the same viewer page. It never
creates a session. Unlike a preview link there is no shareable credential:
the caller's own authorization is the gate on every call.

viewerId.description:
Optional stable viewer identity, as on ResolvePreviewLinkRequest; only
used for logging here (an attach never creates).
